cases.name: escaped family retains outer type

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){class C<U:type>{read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x);}}return C;}const Family=make.<string>("s");new Family.<number>().read();

cases.name: distinct family conversions retain values

steps.source: function make(label:string){class C<T:type>{operator C(v:T){return new C.<T>();}read(){return label;}}return function use(){const raw:any="x";const c:C.<string>=raw;return c.read();};}const a=make("a");const b=make("b");a()+"/"+b();

cases.name: same arguments distinct evaluated families

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();const B=make();String(A.<string>===A.<string>)+"/"+String(A.<string>===B.<string>);

cases.name: family instanceof does not include another evaluation

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();const B=make();const a=new A.<string>();String(a instanceof A)+"/"+String(a instanceof B);

cases.name: specialized instanceof stays separate

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();const B=make();const a=new A.<string>();String(a instanceof A.<string>)+"/"+String(a instanceof B.<string>);

cases.name: distinct captured types and values

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type>{read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");const B=make.<number>(2);new A.<boolean>().read()+"/"+new B.<boolean>().read();

cases.name: captured value parameter survives escape

steps.source: function make<N:uint32>(){return class C<T:type>{read(){return String(N);}};}const A=make.<3>();const B=make.<7>();new A.<string>().read()+"/"+new B.<string>().read();

cases.name: field initializer keeps captured type

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type>{value:T=saved;};}const A=make.<string>("s");new A.<number>().value;

cases.name: explicit argument reads caller type with same name

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type>{read(v:U){const x:T=saved;return String(x)+"/"+String(v);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");function use<T:type>(v:T){return new A.<T>().read(v);}use.<number>(2);

cases.name: default type reads declaration capture

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type=T>{read(v:U){return String(v)+"/"+String(saved);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");function use<T:type>(){return new A.<>().read("x");}use.<boolean>();

cases.name: bare default construction retains capture

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type=number>{read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");new A().read();

cases.name: inferred construction retains capture

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type>{value:U;constructor(v:U){this.value=v;}read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x)+"/"+String(this.value);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");new A(2).read();

cases.name: inferred and explicit construction use one specialization

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{constructor(v:T){}};}const A=make();const a=new A("s");String(a instanceof A.<string>);

cases.name: heritage default retains declaration context

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type=number>{read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");class D extends A{}new D().read();

cases.name: heritage explicit retains declaration context

steps.source: function make<T:type>(saved:T){return class C<U:type>{read(){const x:T=saved;return String(x);}};}const A=make.<string>("s");class D extends A.<number>{}new D().read();

cases.name: static initialization once per family application

steps.source: let effects=0;function make(){return class C<T:type>{static value=++effects;};}const A=make();const B=make();const a=A.<string>;const again=A.<string>;const b=B.<string>;String(a.value)+"/"+String(b.value)+"/"+effects;

cases.name: failed specialization retries without merging families

steps.source: let fail=true;let calls=0;function make(label:string){return class C<T:type>{static value=(()=>{calls++;if(fail)throw new RangeError("fail");return label;})();};}const A=make("a");let caught=false;try{A.<string>;}catch(e){caught=e instanceof RangeError;}fail=false;const B=make("b");String(caught)+"/"+A.<string>.value+"/"+B.<string>.value+"/"+calls;

cases.name: caller type restores after explicit specialization failure

steps.source: class C<T:type>{static fail=(()=>{throw new RangeError("build");})();}function use<T:type>(v:T){let failed=false;try{C.<number>;}catch(e){failed=e instanceof RangeError;}const same:T=v;return String(failed)+"/"+String(same);}use.<string>("caller");

cases.name: recursive static self stays in its family

steps.source: function make(){class C<T:type>{static value=new C.<T>();}return C;}const A=make();const B=make();const a=A.<string>;const b=B.<string>;String(a.value instanceof a)+"/"+String(a.value instanceof b)+"/"+String(b.value instanceof b);

cases.name: private declaration scope survives escape

steps.source: class Outer{#value:string;constructor(v:string){this.#value=v;}make(){const self=this;return class C<T:type>{read(){return self.#value;}};}}const A=new Outer("a").make();const B=new Outer("b").make();new A.<string>().read()+"/"+new B.<string>().read();

cases.name: reflection distinguishes family applications

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();const B=make();const a=new A.<string>();const b=new B.<string>();String(Reflect.typeOf(a)===Reflect.typeOf(b))+"/"+String(Reflect.typeOf(a)===Reflect.typeOf(new A.<string>()));

cases.name: concrete construction does not replay declaration capture

steps.source: let calls=0;function make(){calls++;return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();new A.<string>();new A.<number>();String(calls);

cases.name: distinct own arguments remain distinct

steps.source: class C<T:type>{}String(C.<string>===C.<number>)+"/"+String(C.<T:string>===C.<string>);

cases.name: explicit named argument uses caller alias

steps.source: class C<T:type>{read(v:T){return String(v);}}type A=string;new C.<T:A>().read("s");

cases.name: declaration defaults do not run until application

steps.source: let count=0;function make(){return class C<T:type=string>{static value=++count;};}const A=make();const before=count;A.<>;String(before)+"/"+count;

cases.name: reapplied specialized constructor keeps original family

steps.source: function make(){return class C<T:type>{};}const A=make();const B=make();const S=A.<string>;String(S.<number>===A.<number>)+"/"+String(S.<number>===B.<number>);

cases.name: selected case captures factory lexical values

steps.source: function make(label:string){class C<T:type>{read(){return "base/"+label;}}class C<string>{read(){return "case/"+label;}}return C;}const A=make("a");const B=make("b");new A.<string>().read()+"/"+new B.<string>().read();

cases.name: generic source conversion retains separate captures

steps.source: function make(label:string){return class C<T:type>{operator string(){return label;}};}const A=make("a");const B=make("b");const x:any=new A.<number>();const y:any=new B.<number>();const a:string=x;const b:string=y;a+"/"+b;

cases.name: nongeneric factory control

steps.source: function make(label:string){return class C{read(){return label;}};}const A=make("a");const B=make("b");new A().read()+"/"+new B().read();

new A.<number>().read();

cases.name: finite nested applications retain both in-progress entries

steps.source: class C<N:uint32>{static next=N===0?null:new C.<0>();}const a=C.<1>;String(a.next instanceof C.<0>)+"/"+String(a===C.<1>);

cases.name: partial methods retain their evaluated family

steps.source: function make(label:string){class C<T:type>{}partial class C{read(){return label;}}return C;}const A=make("a");const B=make("b");new A.<string>().read()+"/"+new B.<string>().read();

cases.name: partial extensions update only their family existing applications

steps.source: function make(label:string){class C<T:type>{}const S=C.<string>;partial class C{read(){return label;}}return S;}const A=make("a");const B=make("b");new A().read()+"/"+new B().read();

cases.name: typed nominal boundary refuses another evaluated family

steps.source: function make(){class C<T:type>{}return {value:new C.<string>(),take(v:any){const c:C.<string>=v;return c;}};}const a:any=make();const b:any=make();let rejected=false;try{b.take(a.value);}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}String(rejected);
